4247-4336-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Kobolds of Kher Keep is starting in your graveyard.
4247-4336-5006-8170.description:
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Kobolds of Kher Keep spell. Then, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

678-4022-8249.notablePrerequisites: A permanent you control has left the battlefield this turn
678-4022-8249.description:
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying its mana cost.
When Hidden Herbalists enters, it triggers, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Hidden Herbalists.
When Hidden Herbalists dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Hidden Herbalists from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager.
Repeat.

2374-7084-7272.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
You control another nonland creature.
2374-7084-7272.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Maja triggers, creating a 1/1 white Human Warrior creature token
Resolve Reaper of Flight Moonsilver's ability, giving it +2/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3899-6972-7232.easyPrerequisites: There are at least X tapped lands on the battlefield.
3899-6972-7232.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Ignition Team.
When Ignition Team dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

141-4247-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Naru Meha, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

586-864-3125-5632-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-5632-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Chalk Outline.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and Clue token
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1671-6797-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Simic Growth Chamber.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Simic Growth Chamber.
When Simic Growth Chamber dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Simic Growth Chamber from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

1558-2638-3756-4231-7824.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3756-4231-7824.description:
Play Izzet Boilerworks.
When Izzet Boilerworks enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Izzet Boilerworks trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Bard.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4496-5220-5933-6900.description:
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Accursed Centaur ability.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2724-4006-7638.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using The Mind Stone. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushbringer.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

3259-4478-5768.notablePrerequisites:
Origin of the Hidden Ones has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4478-5768.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Origin of the Hidden Ones' third chapter ability triggers, causing you to create an Assassin token whenever an Assassin attacks this turn and sacrifice Origin of the Hidden Ones.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Assassin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

2440-4720-5685.description:
Activate Propagator Drone by paying {3}{G}, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Eldrazi and Spawn you control.
If needed, activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {G}.
Repeat.
2440-4720-5685.notes: You should only perform step 3 if you have no {G} available. The initial mana cost can be reduced if you control additional Eldrazi and/or Spawns.

3497-4217-7300.notablePrerequisites: You've gained at least 2 life this turn.
3497-4217-7300.description:
Cast Airbender's Reversal by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Lutri by paying its mana cost reduced by Ezzaroot Channeler.
When Lutri enters, it triggers, copying Airbender's Reversal targeting Lutri.
Resolve Airbender's Reversal, airbending Lutri.
Holding priority, cast Lutri from exile by paying {0} due to Ezzaroot Channeler.
Repeat from step 3.

1652-3110-5626.easyPrerequisites: "Chthonian Nightmare" chosen with Council of the Absolute.
1652-3110-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least {E}{E}{E}.
You have a creature card with mana value 3 or less in your graveyard.
1652-3110-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Patron of the Arts and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Patron of the Arts dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning another creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing another creature and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Patron of the Arts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Patron of the Arts enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it

1170-1177-5078-6595.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Narset by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to look at the top four cards of your library, then reveal Sensei's Divining Top and put it into your hand.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}
Lyse Hext and Displacer Kitten trigger.
Resolve the Lyse Hext trigger, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Narset.
Repeat.

2103-5626-6991.manaNeeded: {3}{U}{U} the first turn, with {5}{U}{U}{B}{B} each extra turn
2103-5626-6991.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with mana value 1 or less.
You have at least {E}{E}
2103-5626-6991.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing a creature with mana value 1 or less, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Donnie & April from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Donnie & April enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying at most {E}, sacrificing Donnie & April, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1170-1322-1329-4211.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard.
Cast Tormod's Crypt by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1978-4306-4694.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least three.

uses.n: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders

372-1031-3563.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1031-3563.description:
Cast Flicker of Fate by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Invasion of Arcavios and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Invasion of Arcavios trigger.
Resolve the Invasion of Arcavios trigger, returning Flicker of Fate from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Flicker of Fate.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Invasion of Arcavios and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1322-6575-6684.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of The First Tyrannic War and then putting two lore counters on it.
The First Tyrannic War token's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger. Then, resolve the second trigger, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the third First Tyrannic War trigger, putting two lore counters on Esper Terra and causing you to sacrifice the First Tyrannic War token.
Esper Terra's third and fourth chapter abilities trigger. Resolve the third ability's trigger, creating a token copy of a nonlegendary enchantment you control.
Resolve the fourth trigger, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1525-4985-5751-6504.description:
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, putting a land from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library and causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard for its retrace cost by paying {0} and discarding a land.
Repeat.

1322-1563-2457-3129.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

2713-4499-5419.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Kalain.
When Kalain enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

230-3000-3002-4050.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has a card in exile.
230-3000-3002-4050.description:
Activate Void Attendant by paying {1}{G} and putting a card an opponent owns from exile into their graveyard.
The card is instead put back into exile due to Rest in Peace.
Resolve the Void Attendant ability, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scion and Squirrel, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat.

1365-2292-2744-4404.notablePrerequisites: Corridor Monitor does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
1365-2292-2744-4404.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Corridor Monitor persist until end of turn.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Corridor Monitor.
When Corridor Monitor dies, its persist ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Corridor Monitor enters the battlefield, it and Cathars' Crusade trigger.
Resolve the Corridor Monitor trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 2, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

803-1716-2534.notablePrerequisites:
Kazandu Tuskcaller does not have summoning sickness.
Kazandu Tuskcaller has at least two level counters on it.
"Pirate" chosen with Arcane Adaptation.
803-1716-2534.description:
Activate Kazandu Tuskcaller by tapping it, creating a 3/3 Elephant creature token.
When the Elephant enters the battlefield as a Pirate due to Arcane Adaptation, Coercive Recruiter triggers, untapping Kazandu Tuskcaller.
Repeat.

1379-4365-4853-4917.description:
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure token, creating four 1/1 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}{W}.
Activate Mondrak by paying {1}{W}{W} and sacrificing two Constructs.
When the Constructs die, Dross Scorpion triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat steps 1 through 4 one additional time.
Resolve the second Dross Scorpion trigger from step 7, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Mondrak ability from step 6, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Repeat.

4560-4821.notablePrerequisites: Nonland permanents you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U/R}{U/R}{U}.
4560-4821.description:
Activate all mana producing nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U/R}{U/R}{U}.
Activate Soulfire Grand Master by paying {2}{U/R}{U/R}, causing you to put the next instant or sorcery spell you cast this turn into your hand as it resolves.
Cast Dramatic Reversal by paying {1}{U}, untapping all nonland permanents you control and putting Dramatic Reversal into your hand as it resolves due to Soulfire Grand Master.
Repeat.

2178-4096.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Goblin Welder.
Goblin Welder does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one nontoken artifact creature.
You have at least one artifact creature in your graveyard.
2178-4096.description:
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, sacrificing any artifact creature you control and returning any other artifact creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Goblin Welder triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

24-1167-5049.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping it, and sacrificing it, gaining control of them during their next turn.
Move to their turn.
Cast Wheel of Misfortune for {2}{R}, selecting an arbitrarily large number for the opponent you control, and dealing that much damage to the opponent  if the oponent chose the largest number.
If the opponent didn't choose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals that much damage to each opponent who chose the largest number.
